tools.name: search_compounds
tools.description: Case-insensitive search over published compound names and aliases (brand names, research codes, shorthand like "reta"). Returns the top 10 matches.

tools.name: get_compound
tools.description: Full record for one published compound by slug: aliases, category, evidence tier, routes, typical protocol, half-life, status line, canonical URL.

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: Every tracked vendor that is currently alive: DOSE SCORE (when reviewed), liveness status, last-verified date, trust chips, canonical review URL.

tools.name: best_vendors_for
tools.description: Live offers for one published compound, one best offer per vendor, sorted by price per mg ascending (blends and unpriceable products last). Prices are integer minor units plus display strings.
